title.narrative: Chile's Integrity and Transparency Agenda Support Program
Programa de Apoyo a la Agenda de Probidad y Transparencia de Chile

description.narrative: El objetivo principal de este programa es apoyar la Agenda de Probidad y Transparencia (APT) de Chile, que considera un conjunto de medidas de poltica dirigidas a asegurar la observancia de probidad y transparencia en el funcionamiento del sector pblico y el sector privado, y promover conductas afines en la ciudadana.La presente operacin es la primera de dos consecutivas, vinculadas tcnicamente entre s, pero financiadas de forma independiente bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP).

The main objective of this program is to support Chiles Integrity and Transparency Agenda, which calls for a series of policy measures to ensure integrity and transparency in the operation of the public and private sectors and to promote similar conduct among the citizenry. This is the first of two consecutive operations that are technically linked but separately financed as programmatic policy-based loans.
Commitment in 2015-12-11
Disbursement in second quarter of 2016
